Voice Room needs the microphone to put you in a room.
Talk key

Push to talk asks for a key to hold, and a phone has no keyboard. The volume keys can be it: while push to talk is on in the room, hold either one to open your microphone and let go to shut it. A tap is still the volume, exactly as it always was — which is why it is both keys and not a choice between them. With push to talk off, or anywhere but in the room, they are the phone\'s own again.
